integrity_notes: Definitions and equivalences are proved directly; all numerical claims have a finite reproduction script. Publication priority and external independence are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers original term-justification analogy for idempotent unary maps, not arbitrary unary maps or the distinct similarity-based analogical relation. Finite enumeration is supplementary to an all-cardinality proof. Earlier equivalent publication cannot be excluded.
title: Four-class analogy theorem for idempotent monounary algebras
